newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY MIXED ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY MIXED ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed Thursday's interbank trading session firmer on the U.S. dollar and the mark but was quoted weaker against sterling and rand, dealer said.
"There wasn't too much activity today and the market was stable on the whole, though there were some very tiny movements because one or two guys were buying," commented a dealer.
He said the local unit finished the day at 11.2900/3000 against the U.S. dollar, where it was quoted in the morning but slightly firmer compared to 11.2925/3025 overnight.
It was at 6.6300/6500 from 6.6470/6570 versus the mark, but eased on sterling to 18.5100/5300 from 18.4620/4848.
Against South Africa's rand it also lost marginally to 2.5300/5500 from 2.5230/5260.
